paper_1_general_knowledge.text: The famous Halmidi inscription, regarded as the earliest recorded stone inscription in classical Kannada, belongs to which dynasty?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: The Halmidi inscription discovered in Belur taluk dates to c. 450 AD during the reign of King Kakusthavarma of the Kadamba dynasty.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Karnataka History

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: The Aihole inscription composed by poet Ravikirti describes the victory of Pulakeshin II over which North Indian emperor?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Ravikirti composed the Aihole inscription in 634 AD, detailing Badami Chalukya King Pulakeshin II's decisive victory over Emperor Harshavardhana on the banks of Narmada.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Karnataka History

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: The colossal 57-foot monolithic statue of Gommateshwara at Shravanabelagola was consecrated in 981 AD by:
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Chavundaraya, military general and Prime Minister of Western Ganga King Rachamalla IV, commissioned the Gommateshwara monolith in 981 AD.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Karnataka History

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: The famous rock-cut monolithic Kailasanatha Temple at Ellora (Cave 16) was excavated under which Rashtrakuta king?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Rashtrakuta King Krishna I (756–774 AD) patronized the excavation of the world-famous monolithic Kailasanatha temple at Ellora.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Karnataka History

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: The historic Vijayanagara Empire was founded in 1336 AD on the banks of which river?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Harihara I and Bukka I founded the Vijayanagara Empire on the southern banks of River Tungabhadra near Hampi.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Karnataka History

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Who was the British officer that Rani Chennamma of Kittur defeated in battle in October 1824?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: St. John Thackeray, the Political Agent and Collector of Dharwad, was killed in battle when attacking the Kittur fort in October 1824.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Karnataka History

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Sangolli Rayanna, the legendary military commander of Kittur, was executed by the British at which location in 1831?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Sangolli Rayanna was captured by betrayal and hanged by the British colonial authorities on 26 January 1831 at Nandagad.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Karnataka History

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Which freedom tragedy in Karnataka is widely known as the 'Jallianwala Bagh of Karnataka'?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: On 25 April 1938, British police opened fire on unarmed freedom fighters hoisting the tricolour at Vidurashwatha in modern Chikkaballapur district, killing over 35 people.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Karnataka History

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: The first village in Karnataka to declare independence during the Quit India Movement of 1942 was:
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Villagers of Isur in Shikaripura taluk hoisted the tricolor and declared 'Yashuru' as free independent village in 1942, leading to the execution of 5 patriots.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Karnataka History

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: The Mysore State was officially renamed as 'Karnataka' on 1st November 1973 under the tenure of which Chief Minister?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Chief Minister D. Devaraj Urs officially renamed Mysore State as 'Karnataka' on 1 November 1973.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Karnataka History

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Who among the following founded the famous Bahmani Kingdom in 1347 AD with its initial capital at Kalaburagi (Gulbarga)?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Alauddin Hasan Bahman Shah (Hasan Gangu) founded the Bahmani Sultanate in 1347 with Kalaburagi as its original capital.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Karnataka History

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Who was the celebrated Dewan of Mysore who established the Mysore University (1916) and the Iron and Steel Works at Bhadravati?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Bharat Ratna Sir M. Visvesvaraya served as Dewan of Mysore from 1912 to 1918 and founded Mysore University, KRS Dam, and Bhadravati Iron Works.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Karnataka History

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: The 'Halagali Beda Revolt' of 1857 in Mudhol principality of Karnataka was fought primarily against which British act?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: The Bedas of Halagali revolted valiantly in 1857 refusing to surrender their traditional hereditary firearms under the British Disarming Act.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Karnataka History

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Who presided over the historic Belgaum (Belagavi) Session of the Indian National Congress in 1924?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: The 39th session of the INC at Belgaum in December 1924 was the only Congress session ever presided over by Mahatma Gandhi.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Karnataka History

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Who composed the iconic Kannada state anthem 'Jaya Bharata Jananiya Tanujate'?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Rashtrakavi Kuvempu penned the poem which was officially adopted as the State Anthem of Karnataka in 2004.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Karnataka History

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: What is the highest mountain peak in Karnataka?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Mullayanagiri in the Baba Budan Giri range of Chikkamagaluru district stands at 1,930 meters, making it the highest elevation in Karnataka.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Karnataka Geography

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: The world-famous Jog Falls (Gersoppa) is formed across which river?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Jog Falls (253 m plunge) is formed by the Sharavathi River in Sagara taluk of Shivamogga district.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Karnataka Geography

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: At which confluence do the rivers Tunga and Bhadra merge to form the Tungabhadra River?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Tunga and Bhadra originate in Gangamoola (Western Ghats) and merge at Kudli in Shivamogga district to form Tungabhadra.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Karnataka Geography

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Which village in Karnataka is popularly hailed as the 'Cherrapunji of South India' due to its exceptionally high annual rainfall?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Agumbe in Thirthahalli taluk of Shivamogga district receives over 7,500 mm of annual rainfall.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Karnataka Geography

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: The Almatti Dam constructed across the Krishna River forms a reservoir officially named:
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Almatti Dam forms the Lal Bahadur Shastri Sagar reservoir, while Narayanpur Dam downstream forms the Basava Sagar.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Karnataka Geography

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: The Krishna Raja Sagara (KRS) Dam is constructed just below the confluence of Kaveri with which two tributary rivers?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: KRS Dam is built across Kaveri near Kannambadi where the Hemavati and Lakshmantirtha join the main river.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Karnataka Geography

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Which bird sanctuary in Karnataka is located on an island in the Kaveri river near Srirangapatna?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Ranganathittu Bird Sanctuary in Mandya district comprises 6 islets in the Kaveri river.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Karnataka Geography

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Which national park in Karnataka is famous for its evergreen rainforests and Lion-tailed Macaques, and was declared a World Heritage Site?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Kudremukh National Park in Chikkamagaluru/Dakshina Kannada contains extensive shola-grassland ecosystems and Lion-tailed Macaques.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Karnataka Geography

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: The Ten Degree Channel ($10^\circ\text{ N}$) separates which two island groups in the Bay of Bengal?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: The 10-degree latitude channel separates the Andaman Islands from the Nicobar Islands.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Indian Geography

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Which Indian state shares the longest international land border with Bangladesh?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: West Bengal shares 2,217 km of the total 4,096.7 km India-Bangladesh border.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Indian Geography

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: The older, less fertile alluvium of the Northern Great Plains containing calcareous kankar nodules is called:
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Bhangar is the older alluvial soil deposited above flood plains, containing calcium carbonate nodules (kankar).
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Indian Geography

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Which is the highest mountain peak in the entire Peninsular South India?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Anamudi in the Anaimalai Hills of Kerala stands at 2,695 meters and is the highest peak in South India.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Indian Geography

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: The Standard Meridian of India ($82^\circ 30' \text{ E}$) passes through which town near Prayagraj?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: The Indian Standard Time meridian passes through Mirzapur in Uttar Pradesh ($+5:30$ GMT).
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Indian Geography

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Which two major Indian rivers flow westward through tectonic rift valleys and empty into the Arabian Sea?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Both Narmada and Tapi flow west between Vindhya and Satpura rift valleys without forming deltas.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Indian Geography

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Which is the largest brackish water coastal lagoon in India?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Chilika Lake in Odisha is Asia's largest brackish water coastal lagoon.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Indian Geography

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: The words 'Socialist', 'Secular', and 'Integrity' were added to the Preamble of the Indian Constitution by which amendment?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: The 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act 1976 inserted Socialist, Secular, and Integrity into the Preamble.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Indian Polity

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Which Article of the Constitution abolishes 'Untouchability' and forbids its practice in any form?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Article 17 abolishes untouchability and makes its enforcement a punishable offence under law.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Indian Polity

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Which Article was described by Dr. B.R. Ambedkar as the 'Heart and Soul of the Indian Constitution'?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Article 32 guarantees the Right to Constitutional Remedies, empowering citizens to approach the Supreme Court for writ relief.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Indian Polity

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: The Directive Principles of State Policy (Part IV) in the Indian Constitution were borrowed from the constitution of which country?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Directive Principles (Articles 36 to 51) were adapted from the 1937 Constitution of Ireland.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Indian Polity

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Fundamental Duties were incorporated into Article 51A under Part IVA upon the recommendation of which committee?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: The Swaran Singh Committee recommended incorporating Fundamental Duties during the 42nd Amendment in 1976.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Indian Polity

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Under which Article of the Indian Constitution can the President impose Financial Emergency in India?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Article 360 provides for the proclamation of Financial Emergency (never declared in India so far).
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Indian Polity

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: What is the minimum age prescribed under the Constitution for a person to be eligible for election as a Member of the Lok Sabha?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Article 84(b) prescribes a minimum age of 25 years for Lok Sabha and 30 years for Rajya Sabha.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Indian Polity

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Which constitutional amendment reduced the voting age in India from 21 years to 18 years?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: The 61st Amendment Act 1988 (effective 1989) lowered the voting age for Lok Sabha and Legislative Assemblies to 18.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Indian Polity

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Article 371J of the Constitution providing special reservation for Kalyana-Karnataka was enacted by which amendment?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: The 98th Constitutional Amendment Act 2012 inserted Article 371J for the Hyderabad-Karnataka (now Kalyana-Karnataka) region.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Indian Polity

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: The Eleventh Schedule of the Indian Constitution added by the 73rd Amendment contains how many functional matters for Panchayats?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: The Eleventh Schedule enumerates 29 developmental and administrative subjects entrusted to Panchayati Raj bodies.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Indian Polity

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: What percentage of reservation is provided for women in Panchayati Raj institutions across Karnataka?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Karnataka has enacted 50% reservation for women in all three tiers of Panchayati Raj institutions.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Indian Polity

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Which writ is issued by the Supreme Court or High Court commanding a public official to perform a statutory duty?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Mandamus (meaning 'We Command') compels a public authority or court to execute a mandatory statutory duty.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Indian Polity

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Who acts as the ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha (Council of States)?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Under Article 64, the Vice-President of India is the ex-officio Chairman of the Council of States (Rajya Sabha).
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Indian Polity

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: How many members can the Governor of Karnataka nominate to the Karnataka Legislative Council from literature, science, art, and social service?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Under Article 171(3)(e), 1/6th of total members of Legislative Council are nominated by the Governor.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Indian Polity

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: The Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) of India submits audit reports relating to state accounts to:
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Under Article 151(2), CAG reports relating to the accounts of a State are submitted to the Governor, who causes them to be laid before the legislature.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Indian Polity

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Which blood group is universally called the 'Universal Donor' because its red blood cells lack both A and B antigens?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: O negative (O-) blood lacks A, B, and Rh antigens, allowing it to be safely transfused to any recipient in emergency.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: General Science

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Which hormone secreted by the pancreas regulates glucose levels in human blood by promoting its uptake into cells?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Beta cells of the Islets of Langerhans in the pancreas secrete Insulin to lower blood sugar levels.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: General Science

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: What is the primary gas contributing to the domestic greenhouse effect and global warming?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Carbon Dioxide ($CO_2$) constitutes over 75% of total anthropogenic greenhouse gas emissions driving global warming.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: General Science

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Sound waves cannot travel through which of the following media?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Sound is a mechanical longitudinal wave requiring a material elastic medium for propagation; it cannot travel in vacuum.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: General Science

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Which mirror is commonly used by dentists and as headlamp reflectors in automobiles because it produces an enlarged upright image when object is close?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Concave mirrors are converging mirrors that form magnified, upright virtual images when an object is placed within the focal length.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: General Science

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: What is the SI unit of electric resistance?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Ohm ($\Omega$) is the SI unit of electrical resistance, defined by Ohm's law ($R = V/I$).
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: General Science

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: The blue color of the clear sky during daytime is caused by which optical phenomenon?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Rayleigh scattering states that scattering intensity is inversely proportional to $\lambda^4$; shorter blue wavelengths are scattered far more by atmospheric molecules.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: General Science

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Which chemical compound is commonly known as 'Plaster of Paris'?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Plaster of Paris is Calcium Sulphate Hemihydrate ($CaSO_4 \cdot \frac{1}{2}H_2O$), produced by heating gypsum at 373 K.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: General Science

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Which device converts mechanical kinetic energy directly into electrical energy through electromagnetic induction?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: A generator or dynamo uses Faraday's law of electromagnetic induction to convert mechanical motion into electric current.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: General Science

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Which vitamin is synthesized in the human skin upon exposure to solar ultraviolet rays?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Vitamin D (cholecalciferol) is synthesized photochemically in the skin from 7-dehydrocholesterol by UV-B sunlight.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: General Science

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: The pH value of pure neutral water at $25^\circ\text{C}$ is:
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Pure water has equal concentrations of $H^+$ and $OH^-$ ions ($10^{-7}\text{ M}$), yielding a neutral pH of 7.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: General Science

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Which metal is liquid at standard room temperature ($25^\circ\text{C}$)?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Mercury (Hg) is the only metallic element that remains liquid under standard room conditions.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: General Science

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: What is the primary function of white blood cells (Leukocytes) in the human body?
options: Defend body against infections and pathogens
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Leukocytes (WBCs) form the immune system that neutralizes foreign bacterial, viral, and parasitic infections.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: General Science

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Which gas is released during the natural process of plant photosynthesis in the presence of sunlight?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Photosynthesis uses $CO_2$ and $H_2O$ to produce glucose while releasing Oxygen ($O_2$) as a vital byproduct.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: General Science

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: An object weighs 60 N on the Earth's surface. What would be its approximate weight on the Moon's surface?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Surface gravity on the Moon is $\frac{1}{6}$th of Earth's gravity. Weight on Moon $= 60 \times \frac{1}{6} = 10\text{ N}$.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: General Science

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Find the next number in the arithmetic series: $7, 14, 28, 56, 112, ?$
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Each term is multiplied by 2 ($7 \times 2 = 14, 14 \times 2 = 28$). Next term $= 112 \times 2 = 224$.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Mental Ability

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: In a certain code, 'ROAD' is written as 'URDG'. How is 'SWAN' written in that code?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by $+3$: $S(+3)=V, W(+3)=Z, A(+3)=D, N(+3)=Q \implies \text{VZDQ}$.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Mental Ability

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Pointing to a photograph, Suresh said, 'She is the daughter of my grandfather's only son.' How is the girl in the photograph related to Suresh?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Grandfather's only son is Suresh's father. The daughter of Suresh's father is Suresh's sister.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Mental Ability

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: A train 150 meters long is travelling at a speed of 54 km/h. How many seconds will it take to cross an electric pole?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Speed $= 54 \times \frac{5}{18} = 15\text{ m/s}$. Time $= \frac{\text{Distance}}{\text{Speed}} = \frac{150}{15} = 10\text{ seconds}$.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Mental Ability

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: If 15 men can complete a surveying task in 12 days, in how many days can 20 men complete the same task working at the same pace?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: $M_1 D_1 = M_2 D_2 \implies 15 \times 12 = 20 \times D_2 \implies D_2 = \frac{180}{20} = 9\text{ days}$.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Mental Ability

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: If the price of a commodity increases by 25%, by what percentage must a household reduce its consumption so that total expenditure remains unchanged?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Reduction $= \frac{r}{100 + r} \times 100 = \frac{25}{125} \times 100 = 20\%$.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Mental Ability

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: A clock shows 4:20. What is the acute angle between the hour hand and the minute hand?
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Mental Ability

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Which word cannot be formed using the letters of the word 'REPRESENTATION'?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: 'STATION' requires two 'S's, but 'REPRESENTATION' contains only one 'S'.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Mental Ability

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Find the odd one out among the following numbers: $27, 64, 125, 144, 216$
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Mental Ability

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: The average age of 24 students and their teacher is 15 years. If the teacher's age is excluded, the average age decreases by 1 year. What is the teacher's age?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Total age of 25 people $= 25 \times 15 = 375$. Total age of 24 students $= 24 \times 14 = 336$. Teacher's age $= 375 - 336 = 39\text{ years}$.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Mental Ability

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: A man walks 5 km South, turns left and walks 3 km, then turns left again and walks 5 km. In which direction is he now from his starting point?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Walking 5 km South and 5 km North cancels vertical displacement. He is displaced 3 km East of starting point.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Mental Ability

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Find the missing letter in the series: B, E, H, K, N, ?
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Mental Ability

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: If $A:B = 2:3$ and $B:C = 4:5$, what is the compound ratio $A:B:C$?
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Mental Ability

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: The simple interest on a sum of ₹10,000 for 3 years at 8% per annum is:
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: $\text{SI} = \frac{P \times R \times T}{100} = \frac{10000 \times 8 \times 3}{100} = ₹2,400$.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Mental Ability

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: If January 1, 2024 was a Monday, what day of the week was January 1, 2025?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: 2024 is a leap year (366 days = 52 weeks + 2 odd days). Adding 2 days to Monday gives Wednesday.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Mental Ability

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Under the Government of Karnataka's 'Gruha Lakshmi' flagship scheme, what is the monthly financial assistance transferred via DBT to eligible women family heads?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Gruha Lakshmi deposits ₹2,000 per month directly into the bank accounts of designated women heads of eligible Antyodaya, BPL, and APL families.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Current Affairs & Schemes

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: The 'Shakti' scheme provides free public bus travel for women and transgender persons across Karnataka in which state transport corporations?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Shakti is valid across all 4 state road transport corporations (KSRTC, BMTC, NWKRTC, KKRTC) in ordinary and express buses.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Current Affairs & Schemes

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Under the 'Yuva Nidhi' scheme, what is the monthly financial stipend provided to unemployed Degree Graduates and Diploma holders respectively?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Yuva Nidhi provides ₹3,000 per month for degree graduates and ₹1,500 for diploma holders for up to two years of unemployment.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Current Affairs & Schemes

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Under the 'Anna Bhagya' scheme, when physical rice supply is constrained, the Karnataka Government disburses cash DBT for the additional 5 kg rice at what rate per kg?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: The state provides cash DBT at ₹34 per kg (₹170 per person per month) for the 5 kg rice portion.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Current Affairs & Schemes

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: What is the maximum limit of free domestic electricity provided per household per month under the 'Gruha Jyothi' guarantee scheme?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Gruha Jyothi provides zero electricity bills up to 200 units per month based on the household's 12-month average consumption plus 10%.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Current Affairs & Schemes

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: What is the total expenditure outlay of the Karnataka State Budget 2026–27 presented on 6 March 2026?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: The Karnataka State Budget 2026–27 outlay is ₹4,48,004 crore.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Current Affairs & Schemes

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Who assumed office as the Chief Minister of Karnataka on 3 June 2026 following the state political transition?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: D.K. Shivakumar assumed the office of Chief Minister of Karnataka on 3 June 2026.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Current Affairs & Schemes

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Which new scheme was announced in Karnataka Budget 2026–27 to shift agricultural irrigation pumps to grid-connected solar power feeders?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: The Mukhya Mantri Saura Krishi Yojane solarizes rural agricultural feeders to deliver uninterrupted daytime power to farmers.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Current Affairs & Schemes

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: The Dishank mobile application developed by KSRSAC enables Karnataka citizens to verify which information in real-time?
options: Exact cadastral survey number and land ownership status at their live GPS location
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Dishank uses smartphone GPS to display real-time cadastral survey numbers, village boundaries, and whether land is private, government, or forest.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Current Affairs & Schemes

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Under the Central SVAMITVA scheme implemented with Survey of India, large-scale drone mapping of rural abadi lands is executed at which scale?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: SVAMITVA drone mapping in rural abadi areas is conducted at an ultra-precise 1:500 scale to issue legal property ownership cards.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Current Affairs & Schemes

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: What is the name of Karnataka's online unified property registration portal integrated with Bhoomi and e-Swathu to eliminate middlemen?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Kaveri 2.0 is Karnataka's web-based deed registration software linking directly to Bhoomi for instant mutation initiation.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Current Affairs & Schemes

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Which city in Karnataka is being strategically developed as the secondary technology and semiconductor park under the 'Beyond Bengaluru' initiative in Budget 2026–27?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Mysuru has been prioritized as the state's secondary technology and semiconductor hub under 'Beyond Bengaluru'.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Current Affairs & Schemes

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: The Karnataka Government recently proposed a landmark social policy framework to restrict algorithmic social media access for children under what age?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Karnataka announced a pioneering child safety policy restricting algorithmic social media access for youth under 16 years.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Current Affairs & Schemes

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: What total annual financial allocation is earmarked in Budget 2026–27 to fund the Five Guarantee Schemes?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Budget 2026–27 allocated ₹51,286 crore (approx. 12% of total state outlay) exclusively for the five guarantees.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Current Affairs & Schemes

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Which ISRO lunar mission accomplished the historic soft-landing on the Moon's South Polar region?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Chandrayaan-3's Vikram lander touched down near the lunar South Pole on 23 August 2023, now celebrated as National Space Day.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Current Affairs & Schemes

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: India's first dedicated solar observation space observatory positioned at Lagrange Point 1 (L1) is named:
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: ISRO launched Aditya-L1 to halo orbit L1 to study coronal heating, solar wind, and coronal mass ejections.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Current Affairs & Schemes

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: The 2026 Khelo India University Games were hosted by which South Indian state?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Karnataka successfully hosted youth and university games across Bengaluru's state-of-the-art sports complexes.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Current Affairs & Schemes

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Who was conferred the 58th Jnanpith Award in 2024 for outstanding contributions to Sanskrit and Urdu literature respectively?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Sanskrit scholar Jagadguru Rambhadracharya and renowned lyricist/author Gulzar were jointly awarded the 58th Jnanpith.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Current Affairs & Schemes

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Which wetland in Karnataka was added as the state's Ramsar site in recent years?
options: Aghanashini Estuary, Magadi Kere, and Ankasamudra
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Karnataka expanded its Ramsar wetland footprint with Aghanashini Estuary (Uttara Kannada), Magadi Kere (Gadag), and Ankasamudra (Vijayanagara).
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Current Affairs & Schemes

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: The Bengaluru Metro (Namma Metro) is currently expanding its connectivity to Kempegowda International Airport under which line?
options: Blue Line (Phase 2B from Central Silk Board to Airport)
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: The Blue Line (Phase 2A & 2B) spans 58 km from Silk Board via KR Puram to KIA Airport.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Current Affairs & Schemes

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: In the 2024 Lok Sabha elections, how many parliamentary constituencies were contested in the state of Karnataka?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Karnataka has exactly 28 parliamentary constituencies in the Lok Sabha.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Current Affairs & Schemes

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: What is the primary objective of the 'e-Swathu' software implemented by the RDPR Department in Karnataka?
options: Issuing tamper-proof digital ownership certificates (Form 9 & 11) for rural properties
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: e-Swathu issues digitized, authenticated Form 9 and Form 11 property ownership registers in Gram Panchayats to prevent fraudulent registrations.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Current Affairs & Schemes

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: Which district in Karnataka was carved out as the 31st district of the state in October 2021?
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Vijayanagara (headquartered at Hosapete) was carved out of Ballari district as Karnataka's 31st district.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Current Affairs & Schemes

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: The 'Kalyana Patha' scheme announced in recent Karnataka Budgets is focused on improving:
options: Rural road networks across Kalyana Karnataka assembly constituencies
Silk cocoon markets in Old Mysore
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: Kalyana Patha provides dedicated capital outlays to construct paved rural arterial roads across all assembly constituencies in the Kalyana Karnataka region.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Current Affairs & Schemes

paper_1_general_knowledge.text: India's first indigenous aircraft carrier commissioned into the Indian Navy is:
paper_1_general_knowledge.explanation: INS Vikrant, built at Cochin Shipyard Limited, is India's first indigenously designed and manufactured aircraft carrier.
paper_1_general_knowledge.subject: Current Affairs & Schemes

paper_2_specific_paper.text: If a set $A$ has 5 elements, how many subsets (power set elements) does set $A$ possess?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: The total number of subsets of a finite set with $n$ elements is given by $2^n$. Here $2^5 = 32$.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Mathematics (Arithmetic)

paper_2_specific_paper.text: If $A = \{1, 2, 3, 4, 5\}$ and $B = \{4, 5, 6, 7\}$, what is the intersection set $A \cap B$?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: The intersection $A \cap B$ consists of elements common to both sets, which are {4, 5}.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Mathematics (Arithmetic)

paper_2_specific_paper.text: If $n(A) = 30$, $n(B) = 25$, and $n(A \cap B) = 10$, what is the value of $n(A \cup B)$?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: Formula: $n(A \cup B) = n(A) + n(B) - n(A \cap B) = 30 + 25 - 10 = 45$.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Mathematics (Arithmetic)

paper_2_specific_paper.text: Find the 15th term of the Arithmetic Progression: $3, 7, 11, 15, \dots$
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Mathematics (Arithmetic)

paper_2_specific_paper.text: What is the sum of the first 10 terms of the AP: $2, 5, 8, 11, \dots$?
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Mathematics (Arithmetic)

paper_2_specific_paper.text: Find the 6th term of the Geometric Progression: $2, 6, 18, 54, \dots$
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Mathematics (Arithmetic)

paper_2_specific_paper.text: The sum of an infinite Geometric Progression with first term $a = 12$ and common ratio $r = \frac{1}{3}$ is:
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Mathematics (Arithmetic)

paper_2_specific_paper.text: The product of the HCF and LCM of two numbers is 1800. If one of the numbers is 45, what is the other number?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: $\text{Product} = a \times b \implies 1800 = 45 \times b \implies b = \frac{1800}{45} = 40$.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Mathematics (Arithmetic)

paper_2_specific_paper.text: What is the HCF of the fractions $\frac{2}{3}, \frac{8}{9}, \frac{16}{81}$?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: $\text{HCF of fractions} = \frac{\text{HCF of numerators}}{\text{LCM of denominators}} = \frac{\text{HCF}(2, 8, 16)}{\text{LCM}(3, 9, 81)} = \frac{2}{81}$.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Mathematics (Arithmetic)

paper_2_specific_paper.text: If a number is multiplied by itself and then by itself again, the product is 2197. What is the number?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: The cube root $\sqrt[3]{2197} = 13$ (since $13^3 = 2197$).
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Mathematics (Arithmetic)

paper_2_specific_paper.text: What is the value of the determinant of the matrix $\begin{pmatrix} 5 & 3 \\ 2 & 4 \end{pmatrix}$?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: $\text{Det} = (ad - bc) = (5 \times 4) - (3 \times 2) = 20 - 6 = 14$.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Mathematics (Arithmetic)

paper_2_specific_paper.text: If $A = \begin{pmatrix} 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 3 \end{pmatrix}$ and $B = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 2 \\ 3 & 4 \end{pmatrix}$, what is the element at row 1, column 1 of the product matrix $AB$?
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Mathematics (Arithmetic)

paper_2_specific_paper.text: In how many distinct ways can 5 surveyors be seated in a row for a photograph?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: $5! = 5 \times 4 \times 3 \times 2 \times 1 = 120$ ways.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Mathematics (Arithmetic)

paper_2_specific_paper.text: What is the value of $^7C_3$ (combination of 7 items taken 3 at a time)?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: $^7C_3 = \frac{7 \times 6 \times 5}{3 \times 2 \times 1} = 35$.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Mathematics (Arithmetic)

paper_2_specific_paper.text: The mean of five observations $3, 7, 8, x, 12$ is 8. What is the value of $x$?
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Mathematics (Arithmetic)

paper_2_specific_paper.text: What is the median of the data set: $14, 8, 12, 17, 21, 10, 19$?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: Arranging in ascending order: $8, 10, 12, 14, 17, 19, 21$. The middle (4th) term is 14.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Mathematics (Arithmetic)

paper_2_specific_paper.text: In a frequency distribution, if the Mode is 24 and the Mean is 30, what is the empirical Median?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: $\text{Mode} = 3\text{ Median} - 2\text{ Mean} \implies 24 = 3\text{ Median} - 2(30) \implies 24 + 60 = 3\text{ Median} \implies \text{Median} = 84/3 = 28$.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Mathematics (Arithmetic)

paper_2_specific_paper.text: What is the range of the numbers: $42, 18, 65, 33, 79, 21, 54$?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: $\text{Range} = \text{Maximum} - \text{Minimum} = 79 - 18 = 61$.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Mathematics (Arithmetic)

paper_2_specific_paper.text: If the standard deviation of a dataset is 4, what is its variance?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: $\text{Variance} = (\text{Standard Deviation})^2 = 4^2 = 16$.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Mathematics (Arithmetic)

paper_2_specific_paper.text: If $x + \frac{1}{x} = 5$, what is the value of $x^2 + \frac{1}{x^2}$?
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Mathematics (Algebra)

paper_2_specific_paper.text: If $a + b + c = 0$, what is the value of $a^3 + b^3 + c^3$?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: Standard algebraic identity: When $a + b + c = 0$, $a^3 + b^3 + c^3 = 3abc$.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Mathematics (Algebra)

paper_2_specific_paper.text: Factorize the polynomial expression: $x^2 - 7x + 12$.
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: Numbers that multiply to $+12$ and add to $-7$ are $-3$ and $-4$, giving $(x - 3)(x - 4)$.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Mathematics (Algebra)

paper_2_specific_paper.text: What is the degree of the polynomial $P(x) = 5x^4 - 3x^2 + 7x - 9$?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: The degree is the highest power of the variable, which is 4.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Mathematics (Algebra)

paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: $6x - 12 = 2x + 12 \implies 4x = 24 \implies x = 6$.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Mathematics (Algebra)

paper_2_specific_paper.text: For which condition do the lines $a_1 x + b_1 y + c_1 = 0$ and $a_2 x + b_2 y + c_2 = 0$ represent strictly parallel lines with no solution?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: Parallel lines have identical slopes but different intercepts, so $a_1/a_2 = b_1/b_2 \neq c_1/c_2$.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Mathematics (Algebra)

paper_2_specific_paper.text: What is the nature of the roots of the quadratic equation $3x^2 - 4x + 2 = 0$?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: Discriminant $\Delta = b^2 - 4ac = (-4)^2 - 4(3)(2) = 16 - 24 = -8 < 0$, hence no real roots exist.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Mathematics (Algebra)

paper_2_specific_paper.text: What is the sum of the roots of the quadratic equation $2x^2 - 8x + 5 = 0$?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: $\text{Sum of roots} = -\frac{b}{a} = -\frac{-8}{2} = 4$.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Mathematics (Algebra)

paper_2_specific_paper.text: For what value of $k$ does the quadratic equation $x^2 - kx + 9 = 0$ have equal real roots?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: For equal roots, $\Delta = b^2 - 4ac = 0 \implies (-k)^2 - 4(1)(9) = 0 \implies k^2 = 36 \implies k = \pm 6$.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Mathematics (Algebra)

paper_2_specific_paper.text: What is the distance between the coordinate points $A(2, 3)$ and $B(6, 6)$?
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Mathematics (Coordinate Geometry)

paper_2_specific_paper.text: The distance of the point $P(-5, 12)$ from the origin $(0, 0)$ is:
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Mathematics (Coordinate Geometry)

paper_2_specific_paper.text: What are the coordinates of the midpoint of the line segment joining $P(-4, 6)$ and $Q(8, 2)$?
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Mathematics (Coordinate Geometry)

paper_2_specific_paper.text: The point $P$ divides the line joining $A(1, 3)$ and $B(4, 6)$ internally in the ratio $2:1$. Find coordinates of $P$.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Mathematics (Coordinate Geometry)

paper_2_specific_paper.text: What is the centroid of a triangle with vertices at $(1, 4)$, $(3, 6)$, and $(5, 2)$?
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Mathematics (Coordinate Geometry)

paper_2_specific_paper.text: If the points $(1, 2)$, $(2, 4)$, and $(3, k)$ are collinear, what is the value of $k$?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: Slopes must be equal: $\frac{4-2}{2-1} = \frac{k-4}{3-2} \implies 2 = k - 4 \implies k = 6$.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Mathematics (Coordinate Geometry)

paper_2_specific_paper.text: What is the slope of the straight line $4x - 2y + 7 = 0$?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: Slope $m = -\frac{A}{B} = -\frac{4}{-2} = 2$.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Mathematics (Coordinate Geometry)

paper_2_specific_paper.text: The slope of a line perpendicular to a line having slope $m = -\frac{3}{5}$ is:
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: For perpendicular lines, $m_1 m_2 = -1 \implies -\frac{3}{5} m_2 = -1 \implies m_2 = \frac{5}{3}$.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Mathematics (Coordinate Geometry)

paper_2_specific_paper.text: The area of a triangle formed by the points $(0, 0)$, $(4, 0)$, and $(0, 6)$ is:
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: Right triangle with base 4 and height 6: $\text{Area} = \frac{1}{2} \times 4 \times 6 = 12\text{ sq units}$.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Mathematics (Coordinate Geometry)

paper_2_specific_paper.text: Find the value of $x$ if the slope of the line passing through $(2, 5)$ and $(x, 3)$ is 2.
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: $m = \frac{3 - 5}{x - 2} = 2 \implies \frac{-2}{x - 2} = 2 \implies x - 2 = -1 \implies x = 1$.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Mathematics (Coordinate Geometry)

paper_2_specific_paper.text: The equation of a straight line passing through the origin $(0, 0)$ with slope $m = 3$ is:
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: Point-slope form: $y - 0 = 3(x - 0) \implies y = 3x$.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Mathematics (Coordinate Geometry)

paper_2_specific_paper.text: What is the y-intercept of the line $3x + 4y = 12$?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: Set $x = 0$: $4y = 12 \implies y = 3$.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Mathematics (Coordinate Geometry)

paper_2_specific_paper.text: In standard aerial photogrammetry, what is the recommended forward overlap (longitudinal overlap) along the flight line?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: Forward overlap is maintained at 60% (range 55% to 65%) to ensure stereoscopic 3D coverage of adjacent images.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Modern Surveying

paper_2_specific_paper.text: What is the standard lateral (side) overlap maintained between adjacent parallel flight strips in aerial surveys?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: Side overlap is maintained between 20% and 30% (standard 25%) to prevent gaps caused by aircraft drift.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Modern Surveying

paper_2_specific_paper.text: A vertical aerial photo is taken with focal length $f = 150\text{ mm}$ from a flying height $H = 2000\text{ m}$ above MSL. What is the scale for flat ground at MSL?
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Modern Surveying

paper_2_specific_paper.text: In a truly vertical photograph, the relief displacement of an elevated ground point is always directed:
options: Radially outward from the principal point / nadir
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: Relief displacement $d = \frac{rh}{H}$ is always directed radially outward from the principal point.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Modern Surveying

paper_2_specific_paper.text: The 4 or 8 precision reference marks etched on the frame corners of an aerial camera to locate the principal point are called:
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: Fiducial marks are index marks used to locate the principal point and calibrate film shrinkage.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Modern Surveying

paper_2_specific_paper.text: Which of the following is classified as an Active Remote Sensing system?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: LiDAR transmits its own laser light pulses to measure distances, making it an active sensor.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Modern Surveying

paper_2_specific_paper.text: Healthy green vegetation exhibits exceptionally high reflectance (40% to 60%) in which portion of the electromagnetic spectrum?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: The spongy mesophyll cellular structure of healthy leaves reflects strongly in Near-Infrared ($0.7 - 1.1\,\mu\text{m}$).
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Modern Surveying

paper_2_specific_paper.text: What is the mathematical formula used to compute the Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI)?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: $\text{NDVI} = \frac{\text{NIR} - \text{Red}}{\text{NIR} + \text{Red}}$, ranging from $-1.0$ to $+1.0$.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Modern Surveying

paper_2_specific_paper.text: A digital optical sensor having a 10-bit radiometric resolution can record how many discrete digital grey values?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: Radiometric levels $= 2^{10} = 1024$ levels (from 0 to 1023).
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Modern Surveying

paper_2_specific_paper.text: What is the minimum number of GNSS satellites required simultaneously by a GPS receiver for a 3D position fix and clock bias correction?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: 3 satellites solve for $(X, Y, Z)$ coordinates via trilateration, while the 4th resolves receiver clock bias $\Delta t$.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Modern Surveying

paper_2_specific_paper.text: In satellite positioning, what does a low Position Dilution of Precision (PDOP < 3) indicate?
options: Poor satellite geometry and low accuracy
Excellent satellite geometry and high accuracy
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: PDOP is inversely proportional to accuracy; values $< 3$ indicate widely dispersed satellites yielding high precision.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Modern Surveying

paper_2_specific_paper.text: India's indigenous regional satellite navigation system NavIC (IRNSS) consists of how many operational satellites?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: NavIC consists of 7 operational satellites: 3 in Geostationary Orbit (GEO) and 4 in Geosynchronous Orbit (GSO).
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Modern Surveying

paper_2_specific_paper.text: NavIC satellite signals operate on which primary frequency bands?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: NavIC operates on dual frequencies: L5 band (1176.45 MHz) and S band (2492.028 MHz).
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Modern Surveying

paper_2_specific_paper.text: Which advanced positioning technique uses carrier phase measurements and NTRIP cellular data to achieve 1–2 cm real-time accuracy?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: RTK resolves carrier phase integer ambiguities in real time to provide centimeter-level accuracy.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Modern Surveying

paper_2_specific_paper.text: What is the primary role of a Continuously Operating Reference Station (CORS) network established by Survey of India?
options: Provide permanent GNSS correction streams eliminating the need for a local base station
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: CORS networks provide continuous RTK corrections via internet (NTRIP), allowing a single rover to survey with cm accuracy.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Modern Surveying

paper_2_specific_paper.text: Under the SVAMITVA scheme, rural inhabited village land (Abadi) is surveyed using drones at which map scale?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: SVAMITVA drone mapping in rural abadi areas is conducted at an ultra-precise 1:500 scale.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Modern Surveying

paper_2_specific_paper.text: In GIS, boundary stones, lamp poles, and borewells are best represented by which vector data primitive?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: Discrete zero-dimensional features having only coordinates $(x, y)$ are represented as Points.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Modern Surveying

paper_2_specific_paper.text: In GIS, cadastral land parcels and property ownership plots are represented using which vector data type?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: Closed two-dimensional boundaries enclosing area are represented as Polygons.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Modern Surveying

paper_2_specific_paper.text: The state of Karnataka spans across which two Universal Transverse Mercator (UTM) projection zones?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: Karnataka lies between $74^\circ\text{E}$ and $78.5^\circ\text{E}$, falling in UTM Zone 43N (CM 75°E) and Zone 44N (CM 81°E).
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Modern Surveying

paper_2_specific_paper.text: In the Universal Transverse Mercator (UTM) coordinate system, what False Easting value is assigned to the Central Meridian?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: A False Easting of 500,000 meters is assigned to the central meridian of each UTM zone to avoid negative coordinates.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Modern Surveying

paper_2_specific_paper.text: Which unit of the Central Processing Unit (CPU) performs mathematical calculations and logical comparisons?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: The ALU executes all arithmetic operations (addition, subtraction) and logical decisions (AND, OR, comparisons).
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Computer Applications

paper_2_specific_paper.text: Which is the fastest and smallest memory unit located directly inside the CPU core?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: Registers are high-speed internal memory cells operating at processor clock speed.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Computer Applications

paper_2_specific_paper.text: Which of the following is an open-source operating system whose source code is freely available to the public?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: Linux is an open-source operating system built upon the Linux kernel originally created by Linus Torvalds.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Computer Applications

paper_2_specific_paper.text: Which file extension is standard for ESRI vector geospatial shapefiles used in GIS and cadastral plotting?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: `.shp` is the ESRI Shapefile format storing vector geometry (points, lines, polygons).
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Computer Applications

paper_2_specific_paper.text: In Microsoft Word, which function key initiates the Spelling and Grammar check?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: Pressing F7 in MS Word launches the Spelling and Grammar dialog box.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Computer Applications

paper_2_specific_paper.text: Which feature in MS Word enables batch creation of personalized letters or notices by merging a template with an address database?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: Mail Merge merges a template document with an Excel or Access data source to produce individualized notices.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Computer Applications

paper_2_specific_paper.text: In Microsoft Excel, what type of cell reference is designated by the formula syntax `=$A$1`?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: The dollar signs before both column ($A) and row ($1) fix the reference so it does not change when copied.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Computer Applications

paper_2_specific_paper.text: In MS Excel, which formula function counts all non-empty cells in a range, including cells with text and numbers?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: `=COUNTA()` counts all cells containing any content; `=COUNT()` counts numbers only.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Computer Applications

paper_2_specific_paper.text: In Microsoft PowerPoint, which keyboard shortcut starts the slide show from the very beginning (first slide)?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: F5 starts the presentation from Slide 1; Shift + F5 starts from the currently active slide.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Computer Applications

paper_2_specific_paper.text: In MS PowerPoint, what is the term for visual motion effects that occur when navigating between slides?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: Transitions govern motion between slides; Animations apply to elements within a single slide.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Computer Applications

paper_2_specific_paper.text: Under the Bhoomi project in Karnataka, which statutory document is issued as Form 16 under the KLR Act, 1964?
options: Record of Rights, Tenancy and Crops (RTC / Pahani)
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: Form 16 corresponds to the computerized RTC / Pahani containing comprehensive rights, crops, and tenancy data.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Land Records IT

paper_2_specific_paper.text: Under Section 129 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, Bhoomi processes land mutation petitions based on which principle?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: Bhoomi strictly enforces First-In, First-Out (FIFO) processing to prevent bribery and arbitrary delays.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Land Records IT

paper_2_specific_paper.text: In Karnataka, which pre-registration digital survey sketch is legally mandatory under the Mojini system to partition agricultural land?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: An 11E sketch prepared by a licensed or government surveyor is legally compulsory before registering partitioned land.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Land Records IT

paper_2_specific_paper.text: What is the accelerated administrative scheme in Karnataka allowing individual landholders to subdivide joint survey plots?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: Tatkal Podi enables individual farmers to get their survey hissas separated rapidly without waiting for whole-village surveys.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Land Records IT

paper_2_specific_paper.text: The Dishank mobile application was developed by which state agency to provide real-time cadastral survey numbers on smartphones?
options: KSRSAC (Karnataka State Remote Sensing Applications Centre)
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: KSRSAC developed Dishank to link live smartphone GPS coordinates with georeferenced revenue survey maps.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Land Records IT

paper_2_specific_paper.text: What is the total address length in bits of an Internet Protocol version 4 (IPv4) address?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: IPv4 addresses are 32 bits long, divided into 4 octets separated by dots (e.g., 192.168.1.1).
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Networking & Cybersecurity

paper_2_specific_paper.text: What is the address length in bits of an Internet Protocol version 6 (IPv6) address?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: IPv6 addresses are 128 bits long, written as 8 groups of hexadecimal digits separated by colons.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Networking & Cybersecurity

paper_2_specific_paper.text: Which standard application layer protocol is used for sending outgoing electronic mail messages?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: SMTP (Port 25) is used to send/push email messages; POP3 and IMAP are used to retrieve mail.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Networking & Cybersecurity

paper_2_specific_paper.text: Which cyberattack involves deceptive emails or fraudulent websites designed to trick users into revealing passwords or financial credentials?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: Phishing uses fraudulent communication masquerading as a trustworthy entity to steal credentials.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Networking & Cybersecurity

paper_2_specific_paper.text: What type of malicious software encrypts a victim's files and demands payment in cryptocurrency for the decryption key?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: Ransomware locks or encrypts data files and demands monetary extortion for restoration.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Networking & Cybersecurity

paper_2_specific_paper.text: According to Newton's Universal Law of Gravitation, if the distance between two masses is doubled, the gravitational attraction becomes:
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: Gravitational force follows the inverse square law: $F \propto 1/r^2$. When $r$ doubles, $F$ becomes $1/4$th.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Applied Physics

paper_2_specific_paper.text: What is the internationally accepted value of the Universal Gravitational Constant ($G$)?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: $G = 6.674 \times 10^{-11}\text{ N}\cdot\text{m}^2/\text{kg}^2$, determined by Henry Cavendish using a torsion balance.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Applied Physics

paper_2_specific_paper.text: What are the dimensional units of the Universal Gravitational Constant ($G$)?
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Applied Physics

paper_2_specific_paper.text: What is the value of acceleration due to gravity ($g$) at the physical center of the Earth?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: At Earth's center, depth $d = R$. According to $g_d = g(1 - d/R) = g(1 - 1) = 0$.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Applied Physics

paper_2_specific_paper.text: Why does a body weigh slightly more at the Earth's poles than at the Equator?
options: Polar radius is ~21 km smaller than equatorial radius and centrifugal reduction is zero at poles
Atmospheric air pressure is higher at poles
Earth's magnetic pull is concentrated at poles
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: Because Earth is an oblate spheroid, poles are 21 km closer to the center ($g \propto 1/R^2$), and rotation causes zero centrifugal reduction at $\lambda = 90^\circ$.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Applied Physics

paper_2_specific_paper.text: How does acceleration due to gravity ($g$) vary with increasing height $h$ above Earth's surface for small altitudes ($h \ll R$)?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: Using binomial expansion: $g_h = g(1 + h/R)^{-2} \approx g(1 - 2h/R)$.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Applied Physics

paper_2_specific_paper.text: If the Earth were to suddenly stop rotating on its axis, what would happen to the value of $g$ at the Equator?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: Centrifugal reduction at equator is $\omega^2 R$. Stopping rotation eliminates this outward force, increasing effective gravity.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Applied Physics

paper_2_specific_paper.text: What is the fundamental difference between Mass and Weight?
options: Mass is a vector (N); Weight is a scalar (kg)
Mass is a scalar (kg) constant everywhere; Weight is a gravitational force vector (N) varying with g
Mass varies with altitude; Weight is constant
Mass is measured by spring balance; Weight by beam balance
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: Mass is intrinsic matter measured in kg; Weight is gravitational force $W = mg$ measured in Newtons.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Applied Physics

paper_2_specific_paper.text: An astronaut experiences weightlessness inside an orbiting spacecraft primarily because:
options: Earth's gravity is zero at orbital altitudes
The spacecraft and astronaut are in free fall together toward Earth with zero normal contact force
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: Both satellite and astronaut accelerate toward Earth at $a = g$, making normal reaction force $N = 0$, producing weightlessness.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Applied Physics

paper_2_specific_paper.text: What is the weight of a body of mass 10 kg located at the center of the Earth?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: At Earth's center, $g = 0\text{ m/s}^2$. Therefore, Weight $W = m \cdot g = 10 \times 0 = 0\text{ N}$.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Applied Physics

paper_2_specific_paper.text: The true physical shape of the Earth is geometrically described as a:
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: Earth is a Geoid, bulging at the equator and flattened at the poles due to its axial rotation.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Physical Geography

paper_2_specific_paper.text: What is the inclination angle of the Earth's rotational axis to its orbital plane?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: The axis is tilted $23.5^\circ$ from the perpendicular, which equals $66.5^\circ$ from the orbital plane.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Physical Geography

paper_2_specific_paper.text: On which date is the Earth closest to the Sun (Perihelion) at approximately 147 million km?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: Perihelion occurs around January 3; Aphelion (farthest, 152 million km) occurs around July 4.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Physical Geography

paper_2_specific_paper.text: If it is 12:00 Noon at Greenwich ($0^\circ$), what is the local standard time at Indian Standard Meridian ($82^\circ 30' \text{ E}$)?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: $82.5^\circ \times 4\text{ min} = 330\text{ min} = 5\text{ hours } 30\text{ minutes}$ ahead (5:30 PM).
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Physical Geography

paper_2_specific_paper.text: The boundary of seismic discontinuity separating the Earth's Crust from the underlying Mantle is:
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: The Moho discontinuity separates crust from mantle; Gutenberg separates mantle from liquid core.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Physical Geography

paper_2_specific_paper.text: Which seismic waves travel fastest through solids, liquids, and gases, and arrive first at seismograph stations?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: Primary (P) waves are longitudinal compressional waves having highest velocity, penetrating all states of matter.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Physical Geography

paper_2_specific_paper.text: When sedimentary limestone undergoes metamorphism under intense heat and pressure, it crystallizes into:
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: Limestone recrystallizes into marble; sandstone becomes quartzite; shale becomes slate.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Physical Geography

paper_2_specific_paper.text: In cartography, a village revenue survey map drawn at a scale of 1:1,000 compared to an atlas map at 1:1,000,000 is:
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: A smaller denominator indicates a larger representative fraction ($1/1000 > 1/1000000$), hence a large-scale map.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Cartography

paper_2_specific_paper.text: On standard Survey of India topographical and cadastral maps, which conventional color represents cultivated farmland?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: Yellow represents cultivable agricultural farmland; Green represents forests/wooded areas.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Cartography

paper_2_specific_paper.text: Which physiographic zone of the Northern Great Plains is composed of newer, highly fertile silt deposited by annual river floods?
paper_2_specific_paper.explanation: Khadar is the low-lying active flood plain consisting of fresh alluvial silt deposited annually.
paper_2_specific_paper.subject: Indian Geography
